ClearedFileJson.description:
A source file with marks that say nothing once the line that was
current is archived.

file.description: The file, from the project root.

ClearedMarkJson.description: A mark that says nothing, removed or rewritten.

from.description: Its entry for the target, as written.

line.description: Its line, from 1, before the release.

to.description: The entry as rewritten; null when the mark is removed.

FeatureJson.description: A feature moved by the release.

kept.description: The other targets its spec names, left as they were.

FileJson.description: A source file the release rewrites.

file.description: The file, from the project root.

added.description: The files it gains, by their path in the output.

build.description:
The build: `site`, or an older line's, `site@3.4`. Empty for the
file the lines share.

output.description:
The output: `site`, `plain`, or `json`, or `_ascribe` for the file
the lines share.

description:
What `ascribe versions release --format json` writes: the line released,
the files and marks rewritten, the features moved, and what the release
changes in the outputs.

archived.description:
The line that was current, moved to `archived` with no address,
because no build is versioned by the target.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

cleared.description:
Each source file with marks for the target that say nothing once
`archived` is, removed or rewritten, from the project root.

cleared_features.description:
Each feature whose spec says nothing for the target once `archived`
is, rewritten.

files.description: Each source file whose marks are rewritten, from the project root.

from.description:
The `ascribe.toml` the target's lines are written in, from the
current folder, when the project's `[from]` takes them from another
project's: the release is made in that project, and `files` are from
its root. `null` when they're written in the project's own.

next.description: The line planned after the released one, from `--next`.

outputs.description:
What the release changes in the builds' outputs, by build and
output.

schema_version.description:
The version of this schema. It changes only when a field is removed
or changes meaning.

was_planned.description:
Whether the line was in `planned`; a line that wasn't is a release
nobody planned, such as a patch.

written.description: Whether the files were written: false with `--dry-run`.

title: VersionsReleaseReport
